column1: # The Biognosys iRT standard peptides, with the indexed retention times that
# AlphaPeptDeep's RT model is trained on rt_norm = (irt - min) / (max - min),
# so its raw output is a position on the training gradient in 0..1, not an iRT.
# add_irt_column_to_precursor_df regresses the model's prediction for these 11
# peptides against the values below and applies that line to everything else.
# `sequence` and `irt` columns these are. That fixture also carries the expected
# ONNX predictions and calibrated outputs, which is what test/check_irt.py
# checks ODIA against -- so this table and the numbers it is verified with come
# from the same authority rather than from memory.
# The FIT IS NOT PINNED HERE, deliberately. The slope and intercept depend on
# the model checkpoint, so ODIA recomputes them at run time from these peptides.
